prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Create a friendly, clear, abstract comic-style didactic PNG for DNA structure, landscape roughly16:9, around1600×900 or near native generator size. Match SkillPilot's approachable pale-blue illustrated learning images, rounded shapes and readable black outlines; no photorealism or sterile technical redesign.
Large heading "DNA: Aufbau und Information". Show one large simplified double-stranded DNA model with two sugar-phosphate backbones OUTSIDE and four clearly complementary base pairs INSIDE: A–T, G–C, C–G, T–A. Bases attach to sugars, never directly to phosphate. Backbones contain alternating phosphate circles and sugar pentagons; do not claim a detailed chemical structure. The strands run in OPPOSITE directions: left5′ at top/3′ at bottom, right3′ at top/5′ at bottom, with opposite direction arrows. Keep the sequence letters large.
Beside it, an enlarged single nucleotide detail clearly connected to one complete nucleotide in the strand: a phosphate circle connected to a sugar pentagon, which is connected to one base rectangle. Three large short labels "Phosphat", "Zucker", "Base"; bracket the three-part unit as "Nukleotid". A short bottom caption "Die Basenfolge speichert Information". This is a structure-and-function model, not DNA replication.
Use only these essential short German labels, no explanatory paragraphs or tiny chemical formula details. The nucleotide grouping, opposite strand directions and correct pairing must remain recognizable on a360px-wide phone and at680px on PC. No replication fork, copied DNA, RNA, proteins, enzymes, learner task, answer key, success claims, assessment controls, IDs, logo or watermark. Opaque light background.
